# QR Code generator (C++)

`qrcodegen.cpp` and `qrcodegen.hpp`, unmodified, from Project Nayuki's
QR Code generator library, release v1.8.0
(<https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/cpp>). MIT
licence, in each file's header.

The game draws the pairing page's address as a QR code on the Online
scores screen (src/app/frontend.cpp).
